title: Capability evolution guidance and deterministic conversion coverage controls

surfaces.currentBehavior: Deterministically assigns every Swift service/Auth file and MCP source module in the configured scope to an initial user or operational capability, records source hashes, declared symbols and lexical coupling/read/write/observation/offline signals, and fails generation/checking when any source is unassigned or artifacts are stale.

acceptance: All 41 Swift service/Auth and 47 MCP source files are assigned
An unassigned or changed in-scope source fails generation/checking until reviewed

surfaces.notes: Capability assignment is source triage, not target port/schema approval.

surfaces.currentBehavior: Discovers repository-backed conversion surfaces, including the isolated Ledger target app/core/tests, separately isolated target composition, migration-core and test-support modules/tests, target MCP TypeScript projections, target contract configuration/resources, the two target query-port inventory control leaves, and the two target query logical-authority control leaves; applies bounded classification batches; detects disappearance and live source drift; validates evidence requirements, product authority and vertical-slice implementation dossiers; emits coverage/authority/slice audits; and enforces cumulative M0-M5 gates. Both target query controls are explicitly path-excluded from Firebase audit/repair discovery even when their tests contain contiguous Firebase/source-query sentinel terms. Initial acknowledgment remains one-time; deliberate re-acknowledgment requires an exact reviewed acknowledgeSourceHash that matches the newly observed hash.

surfaces.notes: The explicit hash workflow prevents agents from silently blessing source drift after a characterized file changes. Product-authority roles prevent current or historical Firebase-era specs from silently becoming redesigned target authority. Slice gates prevent implementation/status claims from outrunning exact requirements, contracts, verification and evidence. Separate composition, migration-control and test-support module roots are discovered without placing any of them into Firebase runtime authority. The amended READY baseline adds exact CONFIG discovery and genuine path exclusions for the target query logical-authority controls; contiguous implementation test cases prove the exclusion. No status or ownership change is claimed.

surfaces.currentBehavior: Dependency-free JSON logical-authority crosswalk generator/checker over every generated TQUERY. It fully re-derives the closed upstream inventory schema, relationships, ordering, totals, signature/category/TQUERY identities and digest; enforces registry schemas, exact enums/allowlists/references and review-class consistency; derives collision-checked TACCESS identities and canonical registry-row mapping hashes; canonicalizes all nested output object keys while preserving array order; and accepts exactly one CLI mode. Repository inputs, authority paths, artifact and artifact parent are realpath-contained regular non-symlink paths. Generate uses an unpredictable exclusive no-follow sibling temporary and atomic rename; check is read-only and byte-exact. It performs no free-text keyword or Markdown semantic/status parsing.
